description: This file defines the IndentingWriter class, a custom Java writer that extends FilterWriter to add indentation, newline handling, and spacing features, used within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: IndentingWriter
classes.description: A custom writer that manages indentation, newlines, and spacing for formatted output.

methods.name: makeIndentingWriter
methods.description: Factory method to return an IndentingWriter instance, wrapping a given Writer.

methods.name: IndentingWriter
methods.description: Constructs an IndentingWriter with options for spacing and newline behavior.

methods.description: Inserts a newline into the output, handling indentation as needed.

methods.description: Internal method to handle spacing or indentation after a newline.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Increases indentation level by one unit.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Decreases indentation level by one unit.

methods.name: space
methods.description: Adds a space, considering newline context.

methods.description: Overrides the write method to handle newlines within a character array.
